acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an outdoor barbecue island varies significantly based on size, materials, integrated appliances, and features like refrigeration or custom storage. While a basic island might start around $5,000 to $10,000, more elaborate designs with premium finishes and high-end equipment can exceed $25,000. For our clients in Alameda, we recommend considering the long-term value and durability of materials, as this can influence both the initial investment and ongoing maintenance.
